Air carriers have commercial agreements with SITA to securely transmit passenger and cargo information and provide DHS with two-way communication, as required, via SITA�s approved interface and the usage of SITA�s proprietary software (Runway). Failure to continue the current SITA support services would disavow those carriers currently serviced by SITA preventing them from being able to comply with US government mandates. title: eCMS 2nd Bridge
description: The required services encompass the highly specialized technical, operational, database, and security administration support necessary to sustain the legacy CMiC eCMS application, while simultaneously executing the technical migration of historical project data to the follow-on Kahua system. Continuous operation of this application is vital to the NAVFAC enterprise mission, as it enables quality control workflows between thousands of external construction contractors, Contracting Officer�s Representatives (CORs), Construction Quality Management (CQM) personnel, and Project Managers. While the follow-on eCMS 2.0 contract (N39430-25-C-0010) was successfully competed and awarded to Procon Consulting LLC (Procon) in August 2025, two major, unforeseen external factors stalled the planned transition schedule: 1. A 43-day partial federal government shutdown at the start of Fiscal Year 2026 (FY26). 2. Complex, multi-agency coordination required to obtain the Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) Provisional Authorization (PA) for the new Kahua Cloud Service Provider (CSP) environment. These disruptions created an execution gap that halted database migration tasks requiring proprietary database schema coordination between Bahfed and Procon. A one-year sole-source extension of Bahfed's services is required to bridge this execution gap, maintain the secure cloud hosting environment, deploy security hotfixes, and finalize the structured data transfer to the new competitive platform. The estimated value of this 12-month extension is $3,500,000, based on the Independent Government Cost Estimate (IGCE). The requirement will be funded using Operations & Maintenance, Navy (O&M,N) appropriations.

title: Switzerland – Construction work – Montagebau in Holz
description: Der geplante Neubau des Primarschulhauses Allmend verfolgt das Ziel, eine zukunftsfähige, nachhaltige und pädagogisch funktionale Infrastruktur für die Primarstufe 1 bis 6 zu schaffen. Der viergeschossige Baukörper wird in konventioneller Holzbauweise auf dem Schulareal errichtet und ersetzt dort die bestehende Aussensportanlage („Roter Platz“). Die geologischen und hydrogeologischen Rahmenbedingungen auf dem Areal gelten als anspruchsvoll. Es sind insbesondere zwei voneinander zu trennende Grundwasserstockwerke zu berücksichtigen. Der Baugrund verlangt eine Pfahlgründung (Betonverdrängungsbohrpfähle), auch für Werkleitungen und Kontrollschächte (Holzpfähle). Direct recovery of Te metal and Cd for reintegration into module production. Electricity-driven process supports integration with renewable or nuclear power, lowering lifecycle emissions. Key Advantages Reduced environmental impact: Avoids carbon-intensive bulk chemical manufacturing. Lower logistical burden: Minimizes transportation and storage of hazardous oxidants. Clean energy compatible: Process can run on renewable or low-carbon electricity. Next-generation mining model: Enables sustainable materials recovery aligned with circular economy goals. Market Applications CdTe photovoltaic recycling: Direct application to commercial operations, such as First Solar�s module recovery. title: Finland – Sludge disposal services – Jätevesimädätteen poiskuljettaminen
description: Hankinta koskee jätevesimädätteen poiskuljettamista Metsäsairila Oy:n alueella (Kiertotaloudenkatu 18, 50800 Mikkeli) toimivan yhtiön omistaman biojalostamon varastosäiliöstä. Mädätteen noutoon tarvitaan imuauto, joka päästöluokituksiltaan täyttää Euro VI -kriteerit. Tarjousasiakirjaan on ladattava vapaamuotoinen tiedosto, josta ilmenevät perustiedot palvelun tuottamiseen käytettävästä kalustosta (merkki, vm, euroluokitus, säiliön tilavuus, akselien lkm, päästöt). Mädäte on orgaanista maanparannusainetta, joka täyttää Ruokaviraston sille lannoitekäyttöön asettamat vaatimukset. Mädätettä ei ole separoitu ja sen kuiva-ainepitoisuus on noin 11,5 %. Mädätteen tuotanto on jatkuvaa ja sitä syntyy noin 3 800 - 5 500 tonnia vuodessa. Tuorein, vuoden 2025 lopun näytteistä koostettu tuoteseloste on lisätty tämän tietopyynnön liiteasiakirjaksi. Tuoreempaa tuoteselostetta ei ole, koska reaktori on ollut huoltotoimien vuoksi poissa tuotantokäytöstä kuluneen kesän ajan. Mädätettä syntyy jatkuvasti, joten sen noutokin on jatkuvatoimista. Mädätteen poiskuljetus tapahtuu tilauksesta, josta palvelun tarjoajalla on 1 viikko aikaa noutaa tuote varastosäiliöstä. Varastosäiliö, jonka vetoisuus on noin 750 t mädätettä, ajetaan tyhjäksi yhdellä kertaa tai toimitaan muulla, yhteisesti sovitulla toimintatavalla. Palvelun tuottajan tulee täyttää kaikki tarjouspyyntöön liittyvät ja mädätteen noudosta aiheutuvat kustannukset. Vastuu tuotteesta ja sen hallinta siirtyvät palvelun tuottajalle, kun se on siirretty varastosäiliöstä imuautoon. Palvelu on oltava tarjolla heti sopimuskauden alkaessa.

The following NAICS codes and size standards are anticipated: NAICS 541690 Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services ($19M) NAICS 541715 Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) (1,000 Employees) NAICS 611430 Professional and Management Development Training ($15M) (4) Description. (i) The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), National Center for Emerging and Zoonotic Infectious Diseases (NCEZID), Division of Healthcare Quality Promotion (DHQP), announces its intent to compete a new Indefinite-Delivery/Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract vehicle titled �Safety, Prevention, Epidemiology, and Education Development for Health Care and Antimicrobial Resistance (SPEED).� SPEED will provide CDC with an "as needed" mechanism to obtain healthcare epidemiology, health behavior, and healthcare-associated infection research support across five functional domains: (1) Domestic Antimicrobial Resistance, Infection Prevention and Control, and Adverse Events Services; (2) Healthcare Information Technology and Data Solutions Services; (3) Global Antimicrobial Resistance and Infection Prevention and Control Services; (4) Emergency Preparedness, Response Services, and Healthcare System Resilience Services; and (5) Workforce Training, Message Development, Dissemination, and Testing Services. The anticipated ordering period (period of performance) for the SPEED IDIQ is a 60-month period beginning on March 30, 2027 and ending March 29, 2032. Offerors may submit proposals to one or more domains and will be evaluated on technical approach including existing infrastructure and capacity, staffing approach, management approach, similar experience, price, and past performance. To ensure continuity of critical healthcare epidemiology and infection prevention research support with no lapse in service, DHQP extended the current Safe Healthcare, Epidemiology, Prevention Research Development (SHEPheRD) Program contracts through March 29, 2027, the day immediately preceding the SPEED anticipated effective start date. This extension allows CDC to maintain uninterrupted access to essential scientific, technical, and programmatic support while the SPEED solicitation, evaluation, and award process is completed. DHQP intends for SPEED to fully replace SHEPheRD upon award. CDC will provide further information regarding the solicitation timeline, evaluation criteria, and instructions for interested offerors in forthcoming notices. Interested parties are encouraged to monitor SAM.gov for the official solicitation and any applicable updates. SPEED shall consist of 5 Domains briefly described as follows: Domain 1: Domestic Antimicrobial Resistance, Infection Prevention and Control, and Adverse Events Services. The purpose of this domain is to obtain services that support the design, execution, and assessment of healthcare and community epidemiology research initiatives addressing antimicrobial resistance (AR), infection prevention and control (IPC), and adverse events domestically within U.S. healthcare settings and communities. These implementation services include developing and implementing study protocols, conducting clinical and epidemiologic investigations, evaluating outcomes, and translating research findings into scalable, evidence-based public health interventions. Domain 2: Healthcare Information Technology and Data Solutions Services The purpose of this domain is to obtain services for the development and deployment of digital health systems, advanced analytics, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and machine learning-driven tools, and mathematical modeling to strengthen surveillance, automate data processing, improve data quality, and enhance decision-making across health programs. This includes the ability of Offerors to develop, implement, or maintain healthcare or ancillary medical (e.g., laboratory, pharmacy, etc.) surveillance systems, deploy natural language processing applications and other artificial intelligence tools, conduct human factors engineering, and apply mathematical modeling to optimize system usability, workflow efficiency, and data interpretation Domain 3: Global Antimicrobial Resistance and Infection Prevention and Control Services The purpose of this domain is to obtain services for development and implementation of research projects and protocols focused on antimicrobial stewardship, antimicrobial resistance detection and control, global health coordination, surveillance, and prevention of healthcare-associated infections in global healthcare settings. These tasks include, but are not limited to, conducting program evaluations, clinical investigations, cost effectiveness and disease modeling analyses, and translating findings into scalable and sustainable public health interventions with a particular focus on low- and middle-income countries. Domain 4: Emergency Preparedness, Response Services, and Healthcare System Resilience Services The purpose of this domain is to obtain services to rapidly respond to healthcare quality and safety threats. Services that may be conducted under this domain include supporting CDC's ability to respond effectively and rapidly to outbreaks, emergencies, and public health threats during times of healthcare facility or health system stress or strain. Domain 5: Workforce Training, Message Development, Dissemination and Testing Services The purpose of this domain is to obtain services that strengthen the capacity, knowledge, and preparedness of healthcare workers, public health personnel (including CDC staff), and the general public to prevent infections and reduce the spread of antimicrobial resistance and other infectious disease threats. title: OSTWIND Market Development 2027–2029
description:
Current Situation

OSTWIND and the participating cantons aim to shift commuter traffic toward public transportation and other sustainable modes of transportation. During the current contract period, data-driven potential analyses, business development activities, corporate mobility concepts, licensing agreements, and operational processes were established. Ongoing corporate projects will continue beyond the end of the current contract.


The contractor must therefore fulfill two tasks simultaneously: attract new companies or clusters of companies with high potential for shifting to public transit, and ensure the continuity of existing projects. The contract is structured as a comprehensive service, ranging from market prioritization and negotiations to stable implementation, ongoing support and further development, as well as an orderly handover.


Crucial is the contractor’s ability to design effective processes, coordinate them with OSTWIND and the contracting cantons, put them into operation, monitor them, and further develop them. Proprietary solutions that serve to fulfill the objectives of this contract may be offered separately to corporate clients, provided that the client’s own or other suitable implementation methods are supported to an equivalent degree and that economic interests and dependencies are disclosed transparently.


Project Objectives

The project aims to use data to identify suitable companies and locations with significant relocation potential, approach them, and persuade them to adopt corporate mobility concepts. In collaboration with the companies (clients), OSTWIND, the contracting cantons, and other partners, economically and operationally viable solutions are to be developed and brought to the decision-making stage.


The agreed-upon mobility concepts are to be translated into functional and manageable operational processes, supported throughout the contract period, and further developed based on usage and impact. At the same time, existing company projects must continue without interruption, and the necessary conditions for a future handover and sustainable continued operation must be established. Annual targets (e.g., acquisition of [number] companies with [number] employees, etc.) will be agreed upon with the contractor.


General Terms and Conditions

OSTWIND is awarding a contract for the term from January 1, 2027, to December 31, 2029. There are two options to extend the contract by one year each (maximum contract term: 5 years). OSTWIND has sole discretion to decide whether to exercise the extension options. The decision to extend the mandate is made separately for each option year. Exercising the first extension option does not confer any entitlement to a further one-year extension.


The contractor bears overall responsibility for the methodological, organizational, and procedural integration of the defined work packages. The scope covers the OSTWIND fare network area and the cantons participating in the program: AI, AR, GL, SG, SH, TG, SZ (March only). The focus is on employers, business locations, and clusters with significant potential for sustainable workplace mobility and a substantial connection to public transportation. Municipalities, cantons, transportation companies, and complementary mobility providers will be involved as needed.


The targeted performance objectives are set forth in the tender documents and the associated appendices. The quantities specified serve as planning guidelines and do not constitute a purchase guarantee, unless expressly stated otherwise.


Components of the Request for Proposals

The Terms of Reference, together with the following appendices, form the binding basis for the procurement process:


Appendix 1: Requirements Catalog

Appendix 2: Case Study

Appendix 3: References and Key Personnel

Appendix 4: Price Sheet

Appendix 5: Declaration Sheet

Appendix 6: Evaluation Grid


In the event of discrepancies in the level of detail between the Terms of Reference and an appendix, the specific provisions of the relevant appendix shall apply to the respective subject matter.

description: Genom sitt regleringsbrev har Socialstyrelsen i uppdrag att representera Sverige i den EU-gemensamma styrgruppen för samordnade upphandlingar inom ramen för Joint Procurement Agreement (JPA). Uppdraget omfattar avrop som är kopplade till myndighetens ansvar för att säkerställa försörjningen av läkemedel och övriga sjukvårdsprodukter inför en höjd beredskap samt för att upprätthålla den katastrofmedicinska beredskapen. Därutöver inkluderar uppdraget inköp av läkemedel genom den så kallade frivilliga solidaritetsmekanisen (VSM) i EU i situationer där ordinarie försörjningskanaler inte kan tillgodose den nationella behov. Enheten för Försörjningsberedskap på Socialstyrelsen utvecklar hälso- och sjukvårdens, och omsorgens försörjningsberedskap på strategisk nivå, men också den operativa delen av försörjningsberedskapen, exempelvis genom att bygga upp och förvalta beredskapslager. Utöver detta planerar enheten hur materiel, utrustning och läkemedel ska kunna levereras vid behov – både inom Sverige och internationellt. För att kunna uppfylla dessa uppdrag avser myndigheten att upphandla ett distributionsavtal med en viss lagerhållning. Om ett inköp via olika EU-mekanismer skulle initieras av myndigheten ska leverantören vara redo att ta emot leveransen, lagerhålla och distribuera till de kunder (till exempel regioner eller apotek) som myndigheten anger. Lagringstid och distributionsperiod kan variera beroende av sammanhanget.

title: Norway – Repair and maintenance services – Maintenance and further development of ServiceNow
description: Purpose Norsk Tipping (NT) currently uses ServiceNow, among other things, as IT Service Management and CSM tools and currently has a licence and maintenance agreement through DXC Technology. The contract expires in February 2027 and this procurement is a renewal of the maintenance contract for ServiceNow. NT is looking for a professional cooperation partner who can help maintain and further develop the current system. Tenderers must see possibilities, propose improvements and have good routines for development and support. The CSM module is used by Customer Service (Interactions/Case), Dealer service and some other small user groups (Case). Customer service is among norway's best and requires high efficiency in case handling with focus on quick access to information, getting pressure and high system degree. The system bears the mark that it has lived for almost 10 years. There are some technical debts that we need help cleaning up. Part of this is moving some internal APIs, which have been made available with MID-server, over to exposed facade services which are more responsive. The ITSM module is used to a very large degree by IT Operations, but also on customer service, dealer services (incident) and in Security. The case types in use are: incident, major incident, problem, change and request. NP's internal Service Desk and HR use Agent Workspace. ServiceDesk receives cases via the user portal, chat, telephone, attendance and e-mails that are automatically registered in ServiceNow. The case types they work with are primarily incident and request. It is a well developed Change management with a number of automated standard changes. ServiceNow is receiving more and more changes via pipeline or other integrations from internal Jira. The operational centre is the escalation point for general errors in the systems. They have monitoring and use, among other things, Splunk to receive events. Emphasis will be put on the tenderer ́s experience and competence in addition to operation and maintenance. Tenderers shall be a proactive consultant for the entire spectrum of services the contract covers. Whether there is new functionality in ServiceNow, a need for clearing in technical debts, smart choices around integrations, utilisation of functionality in the existing system based on the supplier knowing NP's business needs or the like. Requirements that shall be met. Norsk Tipping has organised development work in a product development model. The Customer Support product area is responsible for i.a. management and further development of ServiceNow, Genesys Cloud and self-service systems. Developers and consultants from the chosen supplier in this procurement will be important resources in this team together with other internal and external resources. NT has few, but good internal resources with competence in ServiceNow, and it is important to have a professional supplier that provides me good access to resources and who can contribute with expert help. As a starting point, the team consists of a system manager/owner and two system administrators, one of whom is defined as a team architect. The product development area currently consists of two multi-disciplinary teams, but which share internal resources and to a large degree work across.
